messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Yes, you should enable mobile data on your phone. MMS (picture/video messaging) requires mobile data to work, even when you're abroad. Enabling mobile data won't delete any of your photos, contacts, or other information on your phone—it only allows your phone to use the cellular network for internet access when needed.

Please turn on mobile data by using `toggle_data()` on your device. After you do that, let me know, and we'll test if MMS works. If it still doesn't work, we'll check a few other settings like APN/MMSC configuration.

I have turned the mobile data on. Should I now try sending an MMS message to see if it works?

Please review the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
